verdict.rationale: SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts are a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only adjacent features: generic alerts on log patterns, RED/error-rate and Apdex monitoring, and alerts seeded from dashboard panels. Nothing shows SLO definitions, error-budget tracking, or burn-rate alerting, and adjacent alerting earns no credit.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can define SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts
